readme:
# Languager - Language Spoofing Xposed Module ## Overview Languager is an Xposed module that allows you to change the language of specific Android applications, without changing your system language. This is particularly useful against apps that enforce system language settings or buggy apps that fail to show the selected language from app's settings. ## Features - **Per-App Language Selection**: Choose a different language for each app independently - **Comprehensive Language Support**: 26+ languages available including English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew, Hindi, and many more - **User-Friendly Interface**: Easy-to-use UI with app search functionality and intuitive language selection - **Wide Compatibility**: Works on Android 5.0+ (API 21+) with support for both older and newer Android versions - **Efficient Hooking Mechanism**: Hooks all locale-related methods to ensure complete language spoofing ## Technical Details - **Language Spoofing Mechanism**: - Uses Xposed framework for comprehensive method hooking - Targets all locale-related methods across different API levels: - `Configuration.getLocales()` (API 24+) - `Configuration.getLocale()` (API < 24) - `Configuration.locale` property - `Resources.getConfiguration().locale` - `Locale.getDefault()` - `Locale.getDefault(Category)` (API 24+) - `LocaleList.getDefault()` (API 24+) - `LocaleList.getAdjustedDefault()` (API 24+) - Dynamically replaces system locale with user-selected language - Handles API differences between Android versions - **Shared Preferences**: - Uses XSharedPreferences for cross-process configuration storage - Implements world-readable preferences for Xposed module access - Direct key-value storage for app-language mappings ## Requirements - Android device with Xposed framework installed (LSPosed, EdXposed, etc.) - Android 5.0+ (API 21+) ## Installation 1. Install the Languager APK 2. Enable the module in your Xposed framework manager 3. Select the apps you want to apply language spoofing to 4. Reboot your device 5. Open the Languager app to configure language settings for each app ### LSPosed Repository Installation You can also install Languager directly from the LSPosed repository: 1. Open LSPosed Manager 2. Go to Repository tab 3. Add the repository URL: `https://mon231.github.io/com.rel.languager` 4. Find Languager in the list and install it 5. Enable the module and reboot ## Usage 1. Open the Languager app 2. Use the search bar to find specific apps 3. Select your preferred language for each app from the dropdown menu 4. Click "Save Settings" to apply changes 5. Reboot or restart the target apps for changes to take effect ## Supported Languages All language from your system are supported by `Languager`! Just select them.
But NOTE!!! Languager only spoofs the system-language, and won't translate app's strings for you.
In addition, some apps are installed via split-apk and do not have the language you want (they only support the system-language).
To bypass such apps and use your prefered language, temporarly switch your system-language, reinstall the app then select language in `Languager`. ## Implementation Details - **Preference Handling**: Uses `MODE_WORLD_READABLE` with LSPosed's `xposedsharedprefs` flag for secure preference sharing - **Dynamic Locale Creation**: Creates locale objects for all supported languages - **API Level Detection**: Automatically detects device API level and uses appropriate hooking methods - **UI Optimization**: Efficient app list loading with search functionality - **Compatibility Layers**: Special handling for different Android versions and manufacturer customizations ## Building from Source ### Prerequisites - Android Studio 4.0+ - JDK 11+ - Gradle 7.0+ ### Local Build (debug-mode) 1. Clone the repository: ``` git clone https://github.com/mon231/com.rel.languager languager cd languager ``` 1. Build: ``` ./gradlew clean assembleDebug ``` 1. Find the APK at `app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk` ## Troubleshooting - **Module not working**: Make sure it's enabled in LSPosed/EdXposed Manager - **Language not changing**: Try restarting the app or rebooting your device ## Acknowledgements - [Xposed Framework](https://github.com/rovo89/XposedBridge) - [LSPosed Framework](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed)

# Languager - 语言欺骗 Xposed 模块 ## 概述 Languager 是一个 Xposed 模块，允许您更改特定 Android 应用程序的语言，而无需更改系统语言。这对于强制执行系统语言设置的应用程序或无法从应用程序设置中显示所选语言的有缺陷的应用程序特别有用。 ## 特点 - **按应用程序语言选择**：为每个应用程序独立选择不同的语言 - **全面的语言支持**：超过 26 种语言可供选择，包括英语、法语、德语、西班牙语、意大利语、葡萄牙语、俄语、中文、日语、韩语、阿拉伯语、希伯来语、印地语等 - **用户友好的界面**：易于使用的用户界面，具有应用程序搜索功能和直观的语言选择 - **广泛兼容性**：适用于 Android 5.0+ (API 21+)，支持旧版和新版 Android - **高效的挂钩机制**：挂钩所有与语言环境相关的方法，以确保完整的语言欺骗 ## 技术细节 - **语言欺骗机制**： - 使用Xpose框架进行全面的方法挂钩 - 针对不同 API 级别的所有与语言环境相关的方法： - `Configuration.getLocales()` (API 24+) - `Configuration.getLocale()` (API < 24) - `Configuration.locale` 属性 - `Resources.getConfiguration().locale` - `Locale.getDefault()` - `Locale.getDefault(类别)` (API 24+) - `LocaleList.getDefault()` (API 24+) - `LocaleList.getAdjustedDefault()` (API 24+) - 用用户选择的语言动态替换系统区域设置 - 处理 Android 版本之间的 API 差异 - **共享首选项**： - 使用 XSharedPreferences 进行跨进程配置存储 - 实现 Xpose 模块访问的世界可读首选项 - 应用程序语言映射的直接键值存储 ## 要求 - 安装了 Xposed 框架的 Android 设备（LSPosed、EdXposed 等） - Android 5.0+（API 21+） ## 安装 1.安装语言APK 2. 在Xposed框架管理器中启用该模块 3. 选择要应用语言欺骗的应用程序 4. 重新启动您的设备 5. 打开 Languager 应用程序为每个应用程序配置语言设置 ### LSPod 存储库安装 您还可以直接从 LSPod 存储库安装 Languager： 1.打开LSPod Manager 2. 转到存储库选项卡 3. 添加存储库 URL：`https://mon231.github.io/com.rel.languager` 4.在列表中找到Languager并安装 5. 启用模块并重启 ## 用法 1. 打开语言应用程序 2. 使用搜索栏查找特定应用程序 3. 从下拉菜单中为每个应用程序选择您的首选语言 4. 单击“保存设置”以应用更改 5. 重新启动或重新启动目标应用程序以使更改生效 ## 支持的语言 “Languager”支持您系统中的所有语言！只需选择它们即可。
但请注意！ Languager 只会欺骗系统语言，不会为您翻译应用程序的字符串。
此外，有些应用程序是通过 split-apk 安装的，并且没有您想要的语言（它们仅支持系统语言）。
要绕过此类应用程序并使用您喜欢的语言，请暂时切换系统语言，重新安装应用程序，然后在“语言”中选择语言。 ## 实施细节 - **首选项处理**：将“MODE_WORLD_READABLE”与 LSPod 的“xownedsharedprefs”标志一起使用以实现安全首选项共享 - **动态区域设置创建**：为所有支持的语言创建区域设置对象 - **API级别检测**：自动检测设备API级别并使用适当的挂钩方法 - **UI 优化**：具有搜索功能的高效应用程序列表加载 - **兼容层**：针对不同 Android 版本和制造商定制的特殊处理 ## 从源代码构建 ### 先决条件 - Android Studio 4.0+ - JDK 11+ - 摇篮7.0+ ### 本地构建（调试模式） 1. 克隆存储库： ```` git 克隆 https://github.com/mon231/com.rel.languager lang乌格 CD语言器 ```` 1. 构建： ```` ./gradlew clean assembleDebug ```` 1. 在 `app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk` 中找到 APK ## 故障排除 - **模块不工作**：确保在 LSPod/EdXposed Manager 中启用它 - **语言未更改**：尝试重新启动应用程序或重新启动您的设备 ## 致谢 - [Xpose框架](https://github.com/rovo89/XposedBridge) - [LSPosed 框架](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed)
